task_title: Fix shared seed-69 Floor 1 progression timeout

plan_review.notes: Two adversarial reviews corrected the initial timing hypothesis, identified the true premature hand-in race, required legacy-test setup updates, and rejected quest reordering/eager quest evaluation/stage masking/purchase-only guards.

independent_grade.notes: The diff correctly closes the seed-69 merchant stall: returnShopkeeperPrize now requires an active floor1-shopkeeper-errand quest, preventing pre-meet consumption of the rat tail, and it atomically latches fetch-prize before removeItem so same-interaction meet+return (MainGameScene and headless auto-progression) cannot strand the collect objective after the item is gone. Existing floor1-scenario callers already meet first, so the tighter gate is compatible. The new auto-progression regression fails closed on premature hand-in and proves latch + buy/equip/complete without combat/tuning changes. Six-weapon parameterization is slightly redundant for this pure quest boundary, and direct quest.done mutation is a small layer leak, but both are clear and low risk. No determinism, wiring, or import-boundary issues.
